answer: pigment ripple cipher: each identity must mint a pigment token keyed by a cipher bound to one face; the token costs the cube of its mint order, so the first fake pays 1, the tenth 1,000 and the hundredth 1,000,000; ten fakes cost 3,025 and a hundred cost 25,502,500. Each epoch a ripple re-keys every cipher, so one token cannot be replayed and clones cannot pool one pigment.
